name: One More Chance!
original_name: わん・もあ・ちゃんす！
source:
Here’s a nonstandard doujin title: Nanika-Modoki’s latest title One More Chance! features a boy who made a promise with a girl that they would marry when they grew up. However, he died and went to heaven and he was worried about her being lonely, so he was given one more chance to be with her… except that he’s a dog! It’s basically loli bestiality, but if you’re not able to stand that, then there’s always your standard loli/shota fare.

[From Micchi's [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/02/puppy-love/]blog[/url]]
translation:
这是一个非标准的同人标题：Nanika-Modoki的最新标题One More Chance！讲述了一个男孩与一个女孩许下的承诺，他们长大后会结婚。然而，他死了，去了天堂，他担心她孤独，所以又给了他一次和她在一起的机会……只不过他是一只狗！这基本上是萝莉兽交，但如果你无法忍受，那么总有你的标准萝莉/正太票价。

[来自Micchi的 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/02/puppy-love/]博客[/url]]
